sentences.en: Otto Lilienthal was a 19th-century design engineer
sentences.zh: 奥托·利林塔尔是一位19世纪的设计工程师，

sentences.en: who was fascinated by the idea of flying machines.
sentences.zh: 他痴迷于飞行机器的构想。

sentences.en: He meticulously studied the shape of the wings of birds
sentences.zh: 他一丝不苟地研究鸟类翅膀的形状，

sentences.en: and invented a flying apparatus that allowed him to glide short distances.
sentences.zh: 并发明了一种能让他滑翔短距离的飞行装置。

sentences.en: On Sunday, August 9, 1896, Otto went to a hilly region
sentences.zh: 1896年8月9日，星期日，奥托前往一个丘陵地区，

sentences.en: about 50 miles from where he lived in Berlin.
sentences.zh: 距离他居住的柏林约50英里。

sentences.en: He strapped into his glider like a human stork and took three successful flights.
sentences.zh: 他像一只人类鹳鸟一样把自己绑在滑翔机上，完成了三次成功的飞行。

sentences.en: But on his fourth attempt, a strong gust of wind launched Otto up about 50 feet
sentences.zh: 但在第四次尝试时，一阵强风将奥托吹到了约50英尺的高空，

sentences.en: and then careened him toward the Earth.
sentences.zh: 随后又让他失控坠向地面。

sentences.en: He tried to wrestle the glider out of a crash, but failed to do so.
sentences.zh: 他试图努力控制滑翔机以避免坠毁，但失败了。
这次坠落折断了奥托的脖子。

sentences.en: A few years later, two bicycle mechanics in Ohio
sentences.zh: 几年后，俄亥俄州的两名自行车修理工

sentences.en: realized what was wrong with Otto's glider.
sentences.zh: 意识到了奥托的滑翔机出了什么问题。

sentences.en: It required the pilot to move his body to change the center of gravity of the machine.
sentences.zh: 它需要飞行员移动身体来改变机器的重心。

sentences.en: This system gave the pilot limited balance and control.
sentences.zh: 这种系统给予飞行员的平衡和控制能力非常有限。

sentences.en: It would be like trying to maneuver a bicycle only by leaning to one side or another.
sentences.zh: 这就好比试图只靠向一侧倾斜来操控自行车一样。

sentences.en: Orville and Wilbur Wright knew a great deal about balance and control
sentences.zh: 奥维尔·莱特和威尔伯·莱特兄弟对平衡和控制非常了解，
这得益于他们从事自行车制造的工作。

sentences.en: While idly twisting a cardboard box one day,
sentences.zh: 有一天，当他们漫不经心地扭动一个纸板箱时，

sentences.en: the brothers realized they could warp the shape of a fixed wing through a set of wires.
sentences.zh: 兄弟俩意识到他们可以通过一套钢丝来改变固定机翼的形状。

sentences.en: In effect, they could provide a pilot with a handlebar.
sentences.zh: 实际上，他们可以为飞行员提供一个操纵杆。

sentences.en: Tests confirmed that this system provided significantly more control than Otto's glider.
sentences.zh: 测试证实，该系统比奥托的滑翔机提供了更强的控制力。

sentences.en: The rest, of course, is history.
sentences.zh: 当然，剩下的就是历史了。

sentences.en: Otto Lilienthal had built a machine that mimicked the mechanics of birds.
sentences.zh: 奥托·利林塔尔制造了一台模仿鸟类力学的机器。
他是一位真正的工程师。

sentences.en: The Wright brothers borrowed from the much more unlikely source of bicycle physics.
sentences.zh: 而莱特兄弟则借鉴了自行车物理学这一看似不太可能的来源。

sentences.en: The history of invention is full of stories like this.
sentences.zh: 发明史上充满了这样的故事。

sentences.en: People who have knowledge and training and skills can find themselves stuck.
sentences.zh: 拥有知识、训练和技能的人有时会陷入困境，

sentences.en: And then someone comes out of left field and solves the problem.
sentences.zh: 然后就会有局外人横空出世，解决了问题。

sentences.en: Today, we take a close look at the process of creativity.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将深入探讨创造力的过程。

sentences.en: Insights and epiphanies often seem to arise without explanation.
sentences.zh: 灵感和顿悟往往看似毫无征兆地出现。

sentences.en: But researchers increasingly find there is a science to generating them.
sentences.zh: 但研究人员越来越多地发现，产生灵感是有科学依据的。

sentences.en: The alchemy of invention, this week on Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 发明的炼金术，本周《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Whether it's trying to solve a complex issue at work
sentences.zh: 无论是试图解决工作中的复杂难题，

sentences.en: or figuring out how to get your toddler dressed in the morning,
sentences.zh: 还是琢磨早上怎么给蹒跚学步的孩子穿衣服，

sentences.en: all of us grapple with challenges big and small.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都在应对大大小小的挑战。

sentences.en: On the bright side, these problems often come with aha moments.
sentences.zh: 好消息是，这些问题往往伴随着“啊哈”时刻。

sentences.en: You're on a walk or in the shower when, boom, a big idea or a brilliant solution appears out of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 当你正在散步或洗澡时，砰的一声，一个好点子或绝妙的解决方案就凭空出现了。

sentences.en: And what can we do to make them appear more frequently, more predictably?
sentences.zh: 我们能做些什么让它们出现得更频繁、更可预测呢？

sentences.en: At Columbia University, social psychologist Sheena Iyengar has spent many years studying the surprising origin of powerful ideas.
sentences.zh: 在哥伦比亚大学，社会心理学家希娜·艾扬格花费多年研究强大思想的惊人起源。

sentences.en: Sheena Iyengar, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 希娜·艾扬格，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Sheena, on September 13, 1940, a large steamship named the SS City of Benares
sentences.zh: 希娜，1940年9月13日，一艘名为“贝拿勒斯城号”的大型蒸汽船

sentences.en: left the United Kingdom on a 2,500-mile voyage.
sentences.zh: 离开英国，开始了2500英里的航程。

sentences.en: Who was on board, Sheena, and where was the ship headed?
sentences.zh: 希娜，船上都有谁？这艘船要去哪里？

sentences.en: There were about 400 people on this ship.
They were Britishers, and they were headed to Canada.
sentences.zh: 他们是英国人，正前往加拿大。

sentences.en: Why were they leaving the United Kingdom in the middle of World War II?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们在第二次世界大战期间离开英国？

sentences.en: Well, this was at a point of British history during the war where they were really in a bad situation.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是英国战时历史上一个非常糟糕的时刻。

sentences.en: It looked like they were going to lose.
And so they were very quickly trying to evacuate a large number of particularly children.
sentences.zh: 所以他们正非常迅速地试图撤离大量人口，特别是儿童。

sentences.en: The original plan was to evacuate around 210,000 children.
sentences.zh: 最初的计划是撤离约21万名儿童。

sentences.en: But they were just trying to get the children out of the way before bombing started so that the adults would be ready to fight.
sentences.zh: 但他们只是想在轰炸开始前把孩子们转移走，以便成年人能准备好战斗。

sentences.en: So around this time, the Germans had drawn something of a chokehold around shipping lanes to and from England.
sentences.zh: 大约在这个时候，德国人对进出英国的航道实施了某种封锁。

sentences.en: How had they done this, Sheena?
sentences.zh: 希娜，他们是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: Well, essentially, no food or military supplies or fuel could come in and out of England
sentences.zh: 嗯，本质上，没有任何食物、军事补给或燃料能进出英国，

sentences.en: because the Germans had these U-boats, which were boats that could be on top but could also go underwater,
sentences.zh: 因为德国人有U型潜艇，这种船既能在水面航行，也能潜入水下，

sentences.en: at which point they could very stealthily torpedo the Allied ships.
sentences.zh: 届时他们可以非常隐秘地用鱼雷攻击盟军船只。

sentences.en: And they were just very good at this.
sentences.zh: 而且他们非常擅长此道。

sentences.en: The Allies had better accuracy in being able to launch torpedoes, but that every time they would launch a torpedo,
sentences.zh: 盟军在发射鱼雷方面有更高的精度，但每次他们发射鱼雷时，

sentences.en: their communications would get jammed because the Germans had really good technology at that time for jamming the communications,
sentences.zh: 他们的通讯就会受到干扰，因为德国人在当时拥有非常先进的通讯干扰技术，

sentences.en: and they would essentially intercept the torpedoes.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上会拦截鱼雷。

sentences.en: So they wouldn't get hurt, but they would manage to take down many Allied ships.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不会受伤，但却能成功击沉许多盟军船只。

sentences.en: So four days into this voyage, a panic breaks out on the ship.
sentences.zh: 航行四天后，船上爆发了恐慌。

sentences.en: It's being torpedoed by a German U-boat.
sentences.zh: 它正遭到德国U型潜艇的鱼雷攻击。

sentences.en: Do we have any accounts of what that was like on the ship that night, Sheena?
sentences.zh: 希娜，我们有关于那天晚上船上情况的记录吗？

sentences.en: It was a rough weather that night as well.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上的天气也很恶劣。

sentences.en: And so even the people that did manage to get into those lifeboats, even those, many of them did still die because the waters were quite rough.
sentences.zh: 所以即使是那些成功坐上救生艇的人，很多人最终还是死了，因为海面风浪很大。

sentences.en: You know, somewhere around 80 children potentially died.
sentences.zh: 你知道，大约有80名儿童可能遇难了。

sentences.en: We don't have the exact numbers, but an upwards of about 250 people died in total.
sentences.zh: 我们没有确切数字，但总共有超过250人死亡。

sentences.en: So this tragedy makes news all over the world, and it catches the attention of a woman named Hedy Lamarr.
sentences.zh: 这场悲剧震惊了全世界，也引起了一位名叫海蒂·拉玛的女性的注意。

sentences.en: We may need a minute to back up and explain who Hedy Lamarr was.
sentences.zh: 我们可能需要花点时间来回顾并解释一下海蒂·拉玛是谁。

sentences.en: I understand she has an interesting backstory that starts in Vienna, Austria?
sentences.zh: 我听说她有一个有趣的背景故事，始于奥地利维也纳？

sentences.en: Yes, Hedy Lamarr was born in 1914.
sentences.zh: 是的，海蒂·拉玛出生于1914年。

sentences.en: She was a very famous actress.
sentences.zh: 她是一位非常著名的女演员。

sentences.en: And when she's about 17, 18 years old, maybe 19 years old,
She is married to an Austrian arms provider who becomes her first husband.
sentences.zh: 她嫁给了一位奥地利军火商，那是她的第一任丈夫。

sentences.en: And so she, a Jew, becomes the wife of somebody who provides arms to the Germans and the Italians.
sentences.zh: 于是，身为犹太人的她，成了向德国人和意大利人提供武器的人的妻子。

sentences.en: And so at these dinners that her husband would host, she would learn a lot about weaponry that was being used by the Nazis.
sentences.zh: 在丈夫举办的晚宴上，她了解了很多纳粹正在使用的武器装备。

sentences.en: And so even though she wouldn't be allowed to speak at these dinners, she was actually absorbing all of that information.
sentences.zh: 尽管她在这些晚宴上不被允许发言，但她实际上吸收了所有这些信息。

sentences.en: And it's said that she even helped advise her husband at night, you know, when people were gone, about his business dealings.
sentences.zh: 据说，当客人们离开后，她甚至会在晚上为丈夫的商业交易出谋划策。

sentences.en: Now, of course, over time, it's obviously becoming more and more anti-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 当然，随着时间的推移，反犹主义显然越来越严重。

sentences.en: She's feeling more and more uncomfortable with this.
sentences.zh: 她对此感到越来越不安。

sentences.en: She already is known as an actress.
sentences.zh: 她已经是一位知名的女演员了。

sentences.en: So she does get picked up by Hollywood producers, MGM, and takes a ship from London and goes to Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 所以她被好莱坞制片公司米高梅相中，从伦敦乘船前往好莱坞。

sentences.en: So she's now working in Hollywood.
She's widely seen as a star and sometimes described as the most beautiful woman in the world.
sentences.zh: 她被广泛视为明星，有时被称为世界上最美丽的女人。

sentences.en: But because of her backstory, she also wants to help defeat Nazi Germany.
sentences.zh: 但由于她的背景，她也想帮助击败纳粹德国。

sentences.en: She hears about the sinking of the SS city of Benares, and she talks about it with her friend, George Antheil.
sentences.zh: 她听说了“贝拿勒斯城号”沉没的消息，并与她的朋友乔治·安太尔谈论了这件事。

sentences.en: Was George Antheil also an entertainer, Sheena?
sentences.zh: 希娜，乔治·安太尔也是艺人吗？

sentences.en: Well, he was a composer and piano player.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他是一位作曲家和钢琴家。

sentences.en: He was the son of German immigrants, so he was an American, but he certainly had a German heritage.
sentences.zh: 他是德国移民的儿子，所以他是美国人，但他确实有德国血统。

sentences.en: They both learn about what just happened.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都了解了刚刚发生的事情。

sentences.en: And they are also people that happen to, as a hobby, play duets together on the piano.
sentences.zh: 而且他们恰好有一个共同爱好，就是一起弹奏钢琴二重奏。

sentences.en: She was also an accomplished pianist when growing up in Vienna.
sentences.zh: 她在维也纳长大时也是一位造诣颇深的钢琴家。

sentences.en: Legend has it that Hedy and George were sitting at the piano one day when they got an idea that would appear to be well outside their area of expertise.
sentences.zh: 传说海蒂和乔治有一天坐在钢琴前，产生了一个看似完全超出他们专业领域的想法。

sentences.en: How to keep the Nazi U-boats from jamming Allied radio signals and sinking their ships.
sentences.zh: 如何防止纳粹U型潜艇干扰盟军无线电信号并击沉他们的船只。

sentences.en: So let's keep in mind that Hedy does know something about the German technology and how it was able to jam the communications between the Allies.
sentences.zh: 我们要记住，海蒂确实了解一些德国技术，以及它是如何干扰盟军通讯的。

sentences.en: She's now doing a duet, so she also knows about music, and so does George.
sentences.zh: 她现在正在弹奏二重奏，所以她也懂音乐，乔治也是。

sentences.en: And as they play, they both have this inspiration or flash of insight, you might say.
sentences.zh: 当他们弹奏时，他们都获得了灵感或顿悟，你可以这么说。

sentences.en: Hey, look, we're both playing different keys, and yet we're in tune, and we know what we're doing, and it's flowing seamlessly.
sentences.zh: 嘿，看，我们俩弹奏不同的键，但我们音调一致，我们知道自己在做什么，而且配合得天衣无缝。

sentences.en: And that's because we both know what song we're playing, even though we are using different chords, we're holding on to the same rhythm.
sentences.zh: 这是因为我们都知道自己在弹什么曲子，即使我们使用不同的和弦，我们依然保持着相同的节奏。

sentences.en: So we're able to do this with great synchrony.
sentences.zh: 所以我们能够非常同步地做到这一点。

sentences.en: And so the question is, wait, if we could do that with music, is that something we could do with communications that would travel via radio?
sentences.zh: 问题是，等等，如果我们能在音乐上做到这一点，那我们能在通过无线电传输的通讯中做到吗？

sentences.en: So you have these two musicians now who are now playing the same song, and because they know they're playing the same song, even though they're in different keys,
sentences.zh: 现在你有这两位音乐家在弹奏同一首曲子，因为他们知道自己在弹同一首曲子，即使他们处于不同的调式，

sentences.en: they can stay in sync with one another.
How would this work with torpedoes and communications between Allied ships?
sentences.zh: 这在鱼雷和盟军船只之间的通讯中该如何运作？

sentences.en: So the way the Allied ships would send communications, right?
sentences.zh: 盟军船只发送通讯的方式是这样的，对吧？

sentences.en: So you're an Allied ship, and you're sending a torpedo to do damage to this U-boat that's headed your way.
sentences.zh: 你是一艘盟军船只，你正在发射一枚鱼雷去破坏那艘向你驶来的U型潜艇。

sentences.en: And as you're sending the communication for this torpedo to head towards the U-boat, what does the U-boat do?
sentences.zh: 当你发送鱼雷驶向U型潜艇的指令时，U型潜艇会做什么？

sentences.en: It intercepts and jams that communication.
sentences.zh: 它会拦截并干扰该通讯。

sentences.en: And that's because the communication between the Allies and the torpedo are going along one frequency, or we could say like one, you know, one chord.
sentences.zh: 这是因为盟军和鱼雷之间的通讯是在一个频率上进行的，或者我们可以说就像一个和弦。

sentences.en: And so their insight was, what if we were to transmit the message from one radio from a transmitter to a receiver in a way that it keeps moving, just like music can keep moving.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的洞见是，如果我们以一种不断变化的方式从发射机向接收机传输信息，就像音乐可以不断流动一样，会怎样？

sentences.en: So it's essentially hopping, while it would appear like garbage to somebody else, to the people who know what the message is and what it's trying to do,
sentences.zh: 它本质上是在跳频，虽然对其他人来说看起来像垃圾信号，但对于知道信息内容和意图的人来说，

sentences.en: they would be able to follow it along.
So it'll keep hopping in synchrony.
sentences.zh: 所以它会保持同步跳变。

sentences.en: So in other words, instead of transmitting just on one frequency, if I keep changing my frequency as I'm sending my message,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，与其只在一个频率上传输，如果我在发送信息时不断改变频率，

sentences.en: but you know the order in which I'm going to be changing frequencies, you can keep up.
sentences.zh: 但你知道我改变频率的顺序，你就能跟上。

sentences.en: The message comes through, but someone trying to jam any one frequency is not going to have any success jamming my message.
sentences.zh: 信息可以传达，但试图干扰任何单一频率的人将无法成功干扰我的信息。

sentences.en: It's like a constantly changing symphony, and they refer to it as frequency hopping.
sentences.zh: 这就像一场不断变化的交响乐，他们称之为跳频技术。

sentences.en: Now, it's worth pointing out, of course, that George Anteil was the son of German immigrants, as you said, and Hedy Lamarr was from Austria.
sentences.zh: 值得指出的是，正如你所说，乔治·安太尔是德国移民的儿子，而海蒂·拉玛来自奥地利。

sentences.en: When they go to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当他们去美国海军说，我们想出了一种对抗纳粹U型潜艇的方法时，发生了什么，希娜？

sentences.en: Navy to say, we've come up with a way to fight Nazi U-boats, what happens, Sheena?
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们获得了专利，然后把它带给海军，海军实际上认定他们是间谍，并没有采取任何行动。

sentences.en: Well, they get a patent, and then they take it to the Navy, and the Navy actually decides that they're spies, and they didn't do anything with it.
sentences.zh: 它本可以挽救许多生命，但他们什么也没做。

sentences.en: It could have actually saved a lot of lives, but they didn't do anything with it.

sentences.zh: 所以，海蒂·拉玛的发明在第二次世界大战期间没有被使用，但我听说20年后，军方似乎变聪明了？

sentences.en: So, Hedy Lamarr's invention is not used during the Second World War, but I understand that 20 years later, the military sort of wisens up?
sentences.zh: 是的，他们在古巴导弹危机期间使用了它，这是一个了不起的发明。

sentences.en: Yeah, they used it during the Cuban Missile Crisis, and it is an amazing invention.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它是蓝牙和GPS背后的基础。

sentences.en: I mean, it is the basis behind Bluetooth, GPS.
sentences.zh: 没有它，这一切都不可能实现。

sentences.en: Wouldn't have been possible without this.

sentences.zh: 2014年，她与乔治·安太尔一起被追授进入国家发明家名人堂。

sentences.en: Along with George Anteil, she was inducted posthumously into the National Inventors Hall of Fame in 2014.
sentences.zh: 复杂问题的解决方案有时会凭空出现。

sentences.en: Solutions to complex problems sometimes come out of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 谁会想到两个弹钢琴的人会对阻止纳粹潜艇有什么有用的建议呢？

sentences.en: Who would think two people playing a piano have anything useful to say about halting Nazi submarines?
When we come back, the science and the psychology behind lightbulb moments.
sentences.zh: 节目回来后，我们将探讨“灵光一现”背后的科学与心理学。
您正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: When we think of aha moments, we tend to think of them as miracles.
sentences.zh: 当我们想到“灵光一现”的时刻，往往会觉得那是一种奇迹。

sentences.en: Isaac Newton watched an apple fall from a tree, and bam, he came up with a theory of gravity.
sentences.zh: 艾萨克·牛顿看到苹果从树上掉下来，砰的一声，他就想出了万有引力定律。

sentences.en: The Greek mathematician Archimedes lowered himself into a relaxing bath and came up with insights about density and buoyancy.
sentences.zh: 希腊数学家阿基米德在泡澡时，想出了关于密度和浮力的见解。

sentences.en: He is said to have jumped out of the bath and run naked through the streets, exclaiming, Eureka, or I have found it.
sentences.zh: 据说他当时跳出浴缸，赤身裸体地跑上街头，大喊着“尤里卡”，也就是“我找到了”。

sentences.en: At Columbia University Business School, psychologist Sheena Iyengar has studied the steps that lead to lightbulb moments.
sentences.zh: 在哥伦比亚大学商学院，心理学家希娜·艾扬格研究了促成“灵光一现”的步骤。

sentences.en: Sheena, I want you to walk us through some of the components that you say are behind big ideas, and I want to use an iconic example.
sentences.zh: 希娜，我想请你带我们了解一下你所说的那些大创意背后的组成部分，我想用一个标志性的例子来说明。

sentences.en: Many of us today marvel at the Statue of Liberty.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们许多人都对自由女神像赞叹不已。

sentences.en: We think it's meaningful, that it represents a powerful vision of the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 我们认为它意义深远，代表了美利坚合众国的一种强大愿景。

sentences.en: We think of it as being a beacon of hope and freedom.
sentences.zh: 我们视其为希望与自由的灯塔。

sentences.en: But the story of the Statue of Liberty actually starts in a small town in France in the middle of the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 但自由女神像的故事，实际上始于19世纪中叶法国的一个小镇。

sentences.en: A young man named Frederick Auguste Bartholdi seems to have had artistic talent,
sentences.zh: 一个名叫弗雷德里克·奥古斯特·巴托尔迪的年轻人似乎很有艺术天赋，
zh_words: 弗雷德里克·奥古斯特·巴托尔迪

sentences.en: so his mom moves the family to Paris to give him more opportunities.
sentences.zh: 于是他的母亲带着全家搬到了巴黎，为他争取更多的机会。

sentences.en: Can you tell me Frederick Bartholdi's story?
sentences.zh: 你能讲讲弗雷德里克·巴托尔迪的故事吗？

sentences.en: So Frederick Bartholdi was born in the countryside of France.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德里克·巴托尔迪出生在法国乡村。

sentences.en: When he was two, his father passed away.
And shortly thereafter, his mom moved them to Paris because she noticed that Frederick had some real artistic talent,
sentences.zh: 此后不久，他的母亲带着他们搬到了巴黎，因为她注意到弗雷德里克确实有艺术天赋，

sentences.en: and she wanted to give him those opportunities.
sentences.zh: 她想给他提供那些机会。

sentences.en: And so he was raised in Paris, and he learned the skills of art, and in particular, sculpting.
sentences.zh: 于是他在巴黎长大，学习了艺术技巧，特别是雕塑。

sentences.en: When he was a young man, he was among a group of artists that was selected, and they were sent to Egypt.
sentences.zh: 年轻时，他入选了一个艺术家小组，并被派往埃及。

sentences.en: And he was mesmerized by the colossal sculptures that were guarding the ancient Egyptian tombs.
sentences.zh: 他被守护古埃及陵墓的巨型雕塑深深吸引了。

sentences.en: So some years later, after he returns to France, he hears about an interesting project involving the Suez Canal.
sentences.zh: 几年后，当他回到法国，听说了一个关于苏伊士运河的有趣项目。

sentences.en: Tell me a little bit about this.
The Suez Canal was being built, and they put out a call for sculptors.
sentences.zh: 当时苏伊士运河正在建设中，他们向雕塑家发出了征集令。

sentences.en: Well, they put out a call for proposals so that people could suggest a sculpture that would be put there.
sentences.zh: 他们发布了提案征集，希望人们能为那里提议一座雕塑。

sentences.en: And, you know, the idea was this was going to be at the opening of the Suez Canal,
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，这座雕塑将矗立在苏伊士运河的开通仪式上，

sentences.en: and they invited lots of different proposals.
sentences.zh: 他们邀请了许多不同的提案。

sentences.en: And Frederick Bartholdi submitted a proposal for a colossal woman, dressed in robes, carrying a light.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德里克·巴托尔迪提交了一份提案，提议建造一位身穿长袍、手持灯火的巨型女性雕像。

sentences.en: He called it the light to Asia.
sentences.zh: 他将其命名为“照亮亚洲”。

sentences.en: Now, despite having collected multiple proposals, in the end, they decided to just build a small lighthouse there,
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管收集了多个提案，最终他们决定只在那里建一座小灯塔，

sentences.en: which is what stands there today.
sentences.zh: 也就是今天矗立在那里的那座。

sentences.en: So the Suez Canal project goes nowhere, but Frederick Bartholdi returns to Paris,
sentences.zh: 所以苏伊士运河的项目不了了之，但弗雷德里克·巴托尔迪回到了巴黎，

sentences.en: and he gets in touch with a friend of his.
And this friend of his has an idea about a statue that he wants built in America.
sentences.zh: 这位朋友有一个想法，想在美国建造一座雕像。

sentences.en: Well, as we know, you know, the French have this way of creating republics and then dissolving them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，众所周知，法国人总是在建立共和国，然后又将其解散。

sentences.en: He wants to try to restore the faith of the French people in freedom and democracy.
sentences.zh: 他想尝试恢复法国人民对自由和民主的信仰。

sentences.en: So at this point, you know, the United States is actually proving to be a much better success story than the French.
sentences.zh: 当时，美国实际上比法国展现出了更成功的范例。

sentences.en: So he has this idea that in order to restore the French people's faith in freedom and democracy,
sentences.zh: 所以他认为，为了恢复法国人民对自由和民主的信仰，

sentences.en: he's going to build a statue and give that as a gift to the United States,
sentences.zh: 他要建造一座雕像，并将其作为礼物送给美国，

sentences.en: honoring the 100 years of the Declaration of Independence.
sentences.zh: 以纪念《独立宣言》签署100周年。

sentences.en: And then he asks Frederick Bartholdi to build the statue.
sentences.zh: 于是他请弗雷德里克·巴托尔迪来建造这座雕像。

sentences.en: And what is the idea that Frederick Bartholdi comes up with?
sentences.zh: 那么弗雷德里克·巴托尔迪想出了什么主意呢？

sentences.en: Well, we all know what Lady Liberty looks like.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道自由女神像的样子。

sentences.en: And so the question is, where did Frederick Bartholdi get the idea of Lady Liberty?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，弗雷德里克·巴托尔迪是从哪里得到自由女神像构思的？

sentences.en: Well, certainly the idea of this colossal statue comes,
sentences.zh: 当然，这种巨型雕像的构思，

sentences.en: you can see that in his initial proposal that he submitted for the Suez Canal.
sentences.zh: 你可以从他最初为苏伊士运河提交的提案中看出来。

sentences.en: While he's building this sculpture, getting the idea,
sentences.zh: 当他在构思并建造这座雕塑时，

sentences.en: at that time there was a very famous painting that was hanging in Museo de Orsay.
sentences.zh: 当时奥赛博物馆里挂着一幅非常有名的画。

sentences.en: And it was this painting called La Vérité by the famous painter Le Veuve.
sentences.zh: 那幅画叫《真理》，出自著名画家勒·沃之手。

sentences.en: Now, La Vérité means the Lady of Truth.
And if you were to see this painting,
the Lady of Truth has some similarities.
sentences.zh: 你会发现真理女神与自由女神有一些相似之处。

sentences.en: So the positioning is very similar to La Vérité.
sentences.zh: 所以，姿势与《真理》非常相似。

sentences.en: Now, the French were really enamored of concepts like liberty, right?
sentences.zh: 法国人当时非常迷恋自由之类的概念，对吧？

sentences.en: And so the seal for the Second Republic was Libertas, the Roman goddess.
sentences.zh: 第二共和国的印章就是罗马女神“利伯塔斯”。

sentences.en: And that was actually probably jingling in Bartholdi's pocket in the form of a five-franc coin,
sentences.zh: 那可能就在巴托尔迪口袋里的五法郎硬币上叮当作响，
硬币上就印着利伯塔斯。

sentences.en: And then finally, you know, when you look at the face of Lady Liberty,
sentences.zh: 最后，当你观察自由女神的脸时，

sentences.en: many people have commented on the likeness between the face of Lady Liberty
sentences.zh: 许多人都评论过自由女神的脸

sentences.en: and the face of the most important woman in Bartholdi's life,
sentences.zh: 与巴托尔迪生命中最重要女性的脸非常相像，

sentences.en: And when he was asked whether that was the face of his mother, he did not deny it.
sentences.zh: 当有人问他那是不是他母亲的脸时，他并没有否认。

sentences.en: So to summarize, a French artist draws on Egyptian sculptures
sentences.zh: 所以总结一下，一位法国艺术家借鉴了埃及雕塑，

sentences.en: to design something for the Suez Canal.
sentences.zh: 为苏伊士运河设计了一件作品。

sentences.en: When that plan falls through, he teams up with a friend in France
sentences.zh: 当那个计划失败后，他与法国的一位朋友合作，

sentences.en: to raise money for a sculpture in America.
sentences.zh: 为美国的一座雕塑筹集资金。

sentences.en: He draws on a local coin and his mother's face to design the sculpture,
sentences.zh: 他借鉴了当地的硬币和他母亲的脸来设计这座雕塑，

sentences.en: but the story doesn't end there.
sentences.zh: 但故事并没有就此结束。

sentences.en: Today we see the statue, especially with its location in New York Harbor,
sentences.zh: 今天我们看到这座雕像，特别是它位于纽约港的位置，

sentences.en: as a symbol of hope for immigrants and refugees.
sentences.zh: 将其视为移民和难民的希望象征。

sentences.en: How did that transformation come about, Sheena?
sentences.zh: 这种转变是如何发生的呢，希娜？

sentences.en: Because certainly when you look at Lady Liberty,
sentences.zh: 因为当你观察自由女神像时，

sentences.en: there is a broken shackle at her feet,
sentences.zh: 她的脚下确实有一个断裂的镣铐，

sentences.en: which is supposed to commemorate the abolition of slavery.
sentences.zh: 那是为了纪念废除奴隶制。

sentences.en: But yet, as you're correct, it came to become a symbol of freedom
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，它最终成为了一个自由的象征，

sentences.en: that was more than freedom from slavery.
sentences.zh: 其意义远不止于摆脱奴隶制的自由。

sentences.en: Now, at the unveiling, there was a woman by the name of Emma Lazarus.
sentences.zh: 在揭幕仪式上，有一位名叫艾玛·拉扎勒斯的女士。

sentences.en: Emma was a descendant of Spanish and Portuguese refugees.
sentences.zh: 艾玛是西班牙和葡萄牙难民的后裔。
他们当时正在逃避宗教裁判所的迫害。

sentences.en: And she's asked to write something for the opening.
sentences.zh: 她受邀为开幕式写点东西。

sentences.en: Now, she draws on her family's experience
sentences.zh: 她借鉴了她家族的经历，

sentences.en: and essentially writes that famous poem that we all associate with Lady Liberty,
sentences.zh: 写下了那首我们都与自由女神联系在一起的著名诗篇，

sentences.en: who welcomes the yearning masses to her golden threshold.
sentences.zh: 欢迎那些渴望自由的群众来到她的金色门槛。

sentences.en: She writes that poem, and that is read at the time of the unveiling.
sentences.zh: 她写下了那首诗，并在揭幕时被朗读出来。
所以，你有了自由女神像，

sentences.en: and now you have a poem that is giving it an interpretation, a meaning.
sentences.zh: 现在又有了赋予它解读和意义的诗篇。

sentences.en: Now, the poem actually, you know, may not have gone anywhere,
sentences.zh: 这首诗当时可能并没有引起太大反响，
但多年后，大约在20世纪初，

sentences.en: the great-grandchild of Alexander Hamilton, you know,
sentences.zh: 亚历山大·汉密尔顿的曾孙女，

sentences.en: wants to sort of give even more meaning and more attention to Lady Liberty.
sentences.zh: 想要赋予自由女神像更多的意义和关注。

sentences.en: She finds the poem written by Emma Lazarus
sentences.zh: 她在一家旧书店里发现了艾玛·拉扎勒斯写的这首诗，

sentences.en: collecting dust in an old bookstore.
And she then essentially was responsible for having the poem hung on the pedestal
sentences.zh: 于是她负责将这首诗挂在了自由女神像所站立的基座上。

sentences.en: upon which Lady Liberty now stands.
sentences.zh: 也就是自由女神现在站立的地方。

sentences.en: And I think if you put those pieces together, right,
sentences.zh: 我想如果你把这些碎片拼凑在一起，

sentences.en: the story of the sculpture, the poem,
then its association with the original forefathers,
sentences.zh: 以及它与最初开国元勋的联系，

sentences.en: and as you know, Hamilton himself was an immigrant who came here for refuge.
sentences.zh: 而且如你所知，汉密尔顿本人就是为了寻求庇护而来到这里的移民。

sentences.en: And so if you put these pieces together,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你把这些拼在一起，

sentences.en: you have what becomes a very powerful symbol of hope and freedom.
sentences.zh: 它就变成了一个非常有力的希望与自由的象征。

sentences.en: And certainly her location ends up welcoming the yearning masses
sentences.zh: 当然，它的地理位置最终也欢迎了那些从全球各地来到纽约港寻求庇护的、渴望自由的群众。

sentences.en: that come from all across the globe seeking refuge in New York's harbor.

sentences.zh: 我见过几次自由女神像，

sentences.en: I've seen the Statue of Liberty a few times,
sentences.zh: 它确实非常引人注目，非常具有标志性。

sentences.en: and it's really, you know, so dramatic, so iconic.
And of course, when I think of it,
sentences.zh: 我的脑海里已经有了所有这些联想。

sentences.en: I have all these associations already in my head.
sentences.zh: 但你在这里展示的是，这并不是某一个，

sentences.en: But really, what you're showing here is that this was less of one,
you know, magic moment of epiphany
sentences.zh: 而更多是一系列对过去思想和事件的重组。

sentences.en: and more about a series of recombinations of past ideas and past events.

sentences.zh: 然后下一个人创造了新的组合，

sentences.en: and then the next person creates a new combination,
sentences.zh: 接着下一个人又拿这些组合再次进行重组。

sentences.en: and then the next person takes those combinations and recombines yet again.
sentences.zh: 这就是你如何获得一个真正伟大的创意。

sentences.en: And that's how you get a really big idea.
sentences.zh: 伟大的创意不仅仅来自一个人。

sentences.en: A big idea is not just one person.
The one person might have the inspiration,
sentences.zh: 他们创造了最初的组合。
但为了让最初的组合有所发展，

sentences.en: But in order for that initial combination to go places,
sentences.zh: 你本质上需要其他人能够看到那个想法，

sentences.en: you essentially need other people to be able to see that idea
sentences.zh: 并重新构想那个想法的潜力。

sentences.en: and reimagine the potential of that idea.
sentences.zh: 这就是它如何扩展的方式。
当然，在弗雷德里克·巴托尔迪之前，很多人都见过巨大的埃及雕塑，

sentences.en: Now, of course, lots of people had seen giant Egyptian sculptures
sentences.zh: 但他不仅仅是看看而已。

sentences.en: but he did not just look.

sentences.zh: 你还讲了另一个关于观察力的精彩故事。

sentences.en: He filed it away in his memory.
You tell another wonderful story about the power of observation.
sentences.zh: 马萨诸塞州斯普林菲尔德学院的一位体育老师，

sentences.en: a physical education teacher in Springfield College, Massachusetts,
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·奈史密斯的学生们玩橄榄球、棒球、长曲棍球、英式橄榄球和足球。
但在冬天，他们都被关在室内。

sentences.en: James Naisman students played football, baseball, lacrosse, rugby, and soccer.
sentences.zh: 他是如何解决这个问题的，希娜？

sentences.en: But in the winter, they were all cooped up.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是一名老师，一名体育老师，

sentences.en: How did he solve this problem, Sheena?
sentences.zh: 他的老板给了他一个任务，让他做以下事情。

sentences.en: So he was basically a teacher, a gym teacher,
and he was given a task by his boss to do the following.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道青少年是什么样子的。

sentences.en: He had a whole bunch of teenagers.
sentences.zh: 他必须消耗掉他们的精力。

sentences.en: We all know what teenagers are like.
sentences.zh: 所以他需要确保他创造了一项运动。

sentences.en: And he had to get rid of their energy.
And so he needed to make sure that he created a sport
because this was in the winter and it's Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 因为当时是冬天，而且是在马萨诸塞州。

sentences.en: You needed to make a sport that would have the same amount of,
sentences.zh: 你需要发明一种运动，它需要有同样的，

sentences.en: require the same amount of speed and effort
sentences.zh: 需要同样的速度和体力消耗，

sentences.en: and would tucker them out like, you know, soccer, lacrosse, or rugby.
sentences.zh: 并且能让他们感到疲惫，就像足球、长曲棍球或橄榄球那样。

sentences.en: You also needed to make sure that it wasn't so rough
sentences.zh: 你还需要确保它不会太粗暴，

sentences.en: And he wanted to make sure that it was a team sport.
sentences.zh: 而且他想确保这是一项团队运动。

sentences.en: Okay, so those were his tasks.
sentences.zh: 好了，这些就是他的任务。

sentences.en: So first he drew on pieces that he could sort of essentially steal
sentences.zh: 所以首先，他借鉴了一些他基本上可以“窃取”的元素，

sentences.en: And so sports like football, soccer, he says,
okay, what we'll do is we'll have two teams
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们要做的是组建两支队伍，

sentences.en: and they have to get a ball into some kind of a goal.
sentences.zh: 他们必须把球弄进某种球门里。

sentences.en: But, you know, he said, look, we can use the ball
sentences.zh: 但是，他说，你看，我们可以用球，

sentences.en: like what you would use in soccer,
sentences.zh: 就像你在足球里用的那样，

sentences.en: but, you know, they can't use their feet and all that.
sentences.zh: 但是，他们不能用脚之类的。

sentences.en: They got to pass the ball.
So he was able to get a lot of his pieces
sentences.zh: 所以他能够获得很多素材，

sentences.en: just by stealing from things like soccer and lacrosse and rugby.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是通过从足球、长曲棍球和橄榄球等运动中借鉴。

sentences.en: But the main hurdle that he had to then cross is
sentences.zh: 但他随后必须跨越的主要障碍是，

sentences.en: how do I create a game that can be played indoors
sentences.zh: 我该如何创造一种可以在室内进行的比赛，

sentences.en: that's competitive, that's going to feel really competitive
sentences.zh: 既有竞争性，感觉上非常激烈，

sentences.en: and hard to achieve, but at the same time safe.
sentences.zh: 且难以达成，但同时又是安全的。

sentences.en: And so now his experience with another sport,
sentences.zh: 于是，他从另一项运动中获得的经验派上了用场，

sentences.en: which most people hadn't heard of, it was like a, you know,
sentences.zh: 大多数人没听说过，那就像是一种，你知道的，

sentences.en: a sort of hobby sport that very few people played at the time,
sentences.zh: 一种当时很少有人玩的业余运动，

sentences.en: which was called duck on the rock,
where you would have to throw a stone
and topple a stone off of a bigger stone
sentences.zh: 把另一块石头从大石头上击落，

sentences.en: so it would fall into the water.
Now, in his case, what he's thinking,
sentences.zh: 现在，就他的情况而言，他在想，

sentences.en: okay, well, what if I use a peach basket?
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果我用一个桃子篮子呢？

sentences.en: And that is exactly what he used in the original game.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他在最初的游戏中所使用的。

sentences.en: And what we're going to do is we're going to, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们要做的就是，你知道的，

sentences.en: use the soccer ball and throw the soccer ball
such that it has to fall into this peach basket.
sentences.zh: 使其必须落入这个桃子篮中。
